How we work

Three clear phases, from the first conversation to your final approval.

  1. Planning

    Understanding your vision, lifestyle, and aspirations to shape a thoughtful design direction and a clear roadmap for your dream space.

  2. Concept development & 3D

    Bringing your ideas to life through personalized mood boards, site visits, and immersive 3D visuals that help you envision your future space.

  3. Final blueprint

    Translating your approved vision into detailed 2D drawings and a transparent project BOQ, ensuring every detail feels just right for you.

Meet Nungshi Singh

Nungshi founded Artinn Decors in Indirapuram on a simple belief: a well-designed room should make daily life easier, calmer and more personal.

She leads every project herself, from the first conversation to the final drawings. Her approach favours honest materials, generous light, and spaces built to be lived in.

“Your home should feel like you, not like a catalogue.”

Questions we often hear

Which areas do you work in?

Our studio is in Indirapuram, Ghaziabad, and we design apartments, villas and commercial spaces across Delhi NCR, including Ghaziabad, Noida and Delhi.

Will I see a 3D design before work begins?

Yes. In the concept stage you see personalized mood boards and 3D visuals of your space, so you can review the design before anything is final.

What do I receive at the end of the design process?

You receive detailed 2D drawings and a transparent project BOQ (bill of quantities) for the approved design, along with the 3D visuals and mood boards from the concept stage.

How do I start a project with Artinn Decors?

Call or email the studio to book a consultation. We’ll talk through your space, your plans and your timeline, then suggest the next steps.

Let’s plan your space.

Tell us about your home or workspace anywhere in Delhi NCR. We’ll get back to you to set up a consultation.
